retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1980s-themed layout featuring a vertical split-screen between two distinct character environments topped by heavy neon-outlined display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-panel composition featuring a vertical blue divider separating two distinct 1980s-style interior scenes, anchored by large, stacked neon-pink display text at the top and a film-strip border at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical split-screen dividing gendered or thematic spaces
Large-scale display typography dominating the upper third
Film-strip motif acting as a horizontal footer
Color coordination between neon text and interior props
coreInvariants: Neon pink double-outline on all primary display text
Vertical blue dividing line centered between two photographic panels
Film-strip border at the base of the image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects in medium shots, one in each half of the split-screen, occupying the middle horizontal band.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large neon-pink title text in the top section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down the central divider to the two subjects, and finishes at the bottom text footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with props, furniture, and text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pastel Peach and Denim Blue (Subject clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon elements against slightly desaturated, warm-toned photography.

letterConstructionRules: Inner fill is lighter than the outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are stylized with the same neon tube effect as letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy neon display face paired with a small, clean sans-serif for metadata at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, friendly but bold geometry of the 80s display text.
Captures the thick, tubular 70s/80s display aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image with a blue vertical divider. On the left, a girl in an 80s bedroom with pink bedding. On the right, a boy with a guitar in a messy 80s room. Add a film-strip border at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked uppercase text in the top third using a rounded bold sans-serif with a neon pink double-outline and glow effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text neon pink with a visible glow?
Is there a clear vertical blue divider?
Is the film-strip border present at the bottom?
Are the two scenes distinct in their 80s styling?
